We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join a growing team focused on designing, building, and optimizing modern data solutions. This role is ideal for someone with strong hands-on experience in data engineering, data modeling, and cloud-based analytics environments.
 What You'll Do
Design and develop scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes
Build and maintain data models to support analytics and reporting needs
Work closely with business and technical stakeholders to deliver data-driven solutions
Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across the platform
Contribute to architecture discussions, best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives
 Mandatory Requirements
 ✅ Strong experience with SQL 
 ✅ Strong experience with Python 
 ✅ Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
 ✅ Experience in data engineering, data warehousing, and data modeling
 ✅ Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 Nice to Have
 ➕ Power BI 
 ➕ Terraform 
 ➕ Azure 
 ➕ Snowflake 
 ➕ Experience working in cloud-based data environments
 What We Offer
 📍 Hybrid | Romania
 💰 Salary Range: 13,000 - 17,000 RON net/month 
Opportunity to work on large-scale data projects
Collaborative and international work environment
Professional development and learning opportunities
 If you're passionate about building robust data platforms and transforming data into business value, we'd love to hear from you! 🚀
